body:
Backup steps for the first restart onto a build at or after 7cdee39c (w-05ff, ONE-WAY coordination-store migration). Compiled from Opus2 #6510 (2026-11-16 01:34Z), which drew on source and file hashes only; no store was opened. Fable2 puts these in Greg's "restart now" message.

STORES (source: src/codex_home.rs resolve_termal_data_dir, src/persist.rs, src/coordination_persist.rs):
- The data dir is <HOME>/.termal (HOME, else USERPROFILE, from the host process environment). On Central this is normally C:\Users\grzeg\.termal\; Greg confirms.
- coordination.sqlite migrates ONE-WAY, from schema "...-remote-verification-1" to "...-remote-verification-1-causal-pending-1". Older binaries refuse the migrated store.
- termal.sqlite is not migrated by 05ff, but is backed up as a consistent pair.
- Both are in WAL mode.

FILES, copied with TermAl STOPPED, into a dated folder, each store with its sidecars together:
- coordination.sqlite, plus coordination.sqlite-wal and coordination.sqlite-shm if present;
- termal.sqlite, plus termal.sqlite-wal and termal.sqlite-shm if present.

HOSTS:
- Central takes the build at the coming restart. The OLD EXE is target/release/termal.exe, sha256 fa97e2fa198e347bd250298135dd4726764b85862f9db542542adf065cf18c9f (Nov 15 09:02). Opus2's install swap renames it to target/release/termal.exe.fa97e2fa.bak. ROLLBACK means that .bak PLUS the restored backup set, never the exe alone.
- DL560 does NOT take this build at the Central restart, only at its later remote rollout (after w-97bc and w-ab6c). Its backup of the same files is owed before THAT rollout.
- Mac: it is a federation peer (aarch64, macOS), so it runs a TermAl host. The same rule applies at its own rollout.
Agents never open a live store; Greg performs the backup and the restart.
